variant.briefing:
Hi,

Keeping Citizens for Prosperity outposts stocked with supplies is key to our mission in this system. Happy folks make happy homes. Can you help us deliver some much needed provisions to a few of them? 

Everything can be collected at [Location]. Then here’s the breakdown of where everything goes: 

Package #[Item1] to [Destination].
Package #[Item4] to [Destination].
Package #[Item5] to [Destination1].
Package #[Item2] to [Destination1].
Package #[Item3] to [Destination2].

Great way to make some creds and see a few of the CFP’s thriving outposts.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
